electricityContract.terms: For full terms and conditions, visit https://nextbusinessenergy.com.au/indigopower/IPMTerms, or call Indigo Power on 1800 491 739.

discounts.description: Discount amount stated is an estimate. Actual discount percentage amount will vary depending on customer's actual usage during Daytime Rebate period of 11am - 4pm daily. Credit of 14.64c/kWh (inc GST) (based on distribution zone) for electricity all year, between 11am and 4pm applies to usage charges only, and excludes controlled load, up to 50 kWh/day.

electricityContract.variation: Our energy prices may vary due to changes in the market and economic conditions. By entering into this Contract, you agree that we may vary your rates. You will be notified of any price change in writing at least 5 business days before effective date.

eligibility.information: This offer is only available to Indigo Power Retail customers on a relevant network tariff with a Smart Meter.Indigo Power Retail is a trading name of Next Business Energy Pty Ltd, a licensed energy retailer.
